data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 茶杯旁的第一声雨
data.description: 雨将落下的清晨，有珠穿烟灰羊毛长裙，把深梅色披肩拢好，坐在洋馆早餐桌前。她用茶匙接住将落下的茶滴，抬眼听第一阵雨点敲窗，动作依然安静而精确。
data.action: 用茶匙接住壶嘴的茶滴，抬眼聆听初雨。
data.lighting: cool window light with warm lamp fill
data.promptProse: The first raindrops reach the manor window as Alice Kuonji pauses over her breakfast tea. A dark plum shawl rests around the high ivory collar of her smoke-grey wool dress. Seated upright, she catches a stray drop beneath the teapot spout with the spoon before lifting her dark eyes toward the sound. Cool morning light and a small warm table lamp define the short dark hair, porcelain and deliberate hands. One quiet figure, no lettering.
